headline: Iraola tempers Liverpool title talk, Maresca says Donnarumma is droppable, and more – as it happened
body: ⚽ News and previews heading into the weekend’s action ⚽ Premier League: 10 things to look out for | Mail Andy Dejan Kulusevski returned to competitive action for Tottenham after a 17-month injury layoff to play the last few minutes in the club’s 3-1 home victory against Coventry last week and followed that up with another substitute appearance in Saturday’s win at Chelsea. Kulusevski had multiple setbacks after knee surgery in May 2025. But a second procedure in March finally set him on the road to recovery. Continue reading...
